summary: Describes Zstandard (zstd), a lossless data compression mechanism, and registers a media type, a content encoding and a structured syntax suffix for carrying zstd data in MIME. Despite the name, the document is informational and the format is not an IETF standard.

eli5.summary: Zstandard shrinks files so they take less space and travel faster, then restores them perfectly. This document describes it and gives it official names so web and email software can label compressed content.
